name: F1a_triangle_apex_above
sw_rationale: Family 1 (Solution branch / triangle flip). An isoceles triangle: base p1=(0,0) p2=(60,0) fixed, apex p3 initial at (30,35) ABOVE the base. Two equal side constraints + base fixed. The solver must stay on the ABOVE branch because initial geometry is there. SolidWorks locks to the nearest branch. SW correct: apex at (30, ~34.785) where side = sqrt(30^2+h^2) = 40, so h = sqrt(40^2-30^2) = sqrt(700) ~ 26.458. Confidence: HIGH for branch selection (SolidWorks always stays on initial-geometry side), MEDIUM for exact coord (depends on equal-length constraint settling).

expect._coord_notes: apex p3 must be ABOVE base: p3.y > 0. h = sqrt(40^2 - 30^2) = sqrt(700) ~ 26.458. p3 = (30, 26.458). The BELOW branch p3.y ~ -26.458 must NOT appear.
